mission.title: Emergency: Blinding Hope in Trouble
mission.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blinding Hope in trouble

WORK BRIEF: 
We received a distress call from the Blinding Hope that said they were under attack from the Moraine again before they were cut off. I just want to know if they're okay. <EM4>Head to their last known location and report what you find</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
